description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is available for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh: 本地录像上传任务ID，由创建本地录像上传任务[CreateLocalFileUploadJob](~~363002~~)生成。
description.en: The ID of the local recording upload task, which is generated by calling [CreateLocalFileUploadJob](~~363002~~).

title.zh: 停止本地录像上传任务
title.en: Stop a local recording upload task

descriptions.zh: 停止本地录像上传任务后，已经创建的录像文件不会删除。
descriptions.en: After you stop a local recording upload task, the recording files that are already created are not deleted.
